rationale: Softens only the deepest reverse-tail recurrent pass during the main training phase, then ramps it back toward the exact full-gain evaluation profile once the existing quant-aware endgame starts. This keeps the proven 9x512 reverse-tail/export path, preserves VAL_LOSS_EVERY=0 and the final int8+zlib roundtrip, and tests a compact recurrence-scheduling change instead of another scalar sweep.
title: Quant-Phase Final Tail Gain Close
